pictures.author: Ifteebd10
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×720 night courtyard view. Tall flat-topped cubic prayer hall with three dark horizontal bands near the roof; projecting triple-pointed-arch entrance with taller middle arch; lower wings have repetitive tall narrow openings. This image supports shape; nighttime colored lights are not baked into the palette or textures. Fine lit calligraphy and people omitted.

pictures.author: T. Galib
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×720 daylight courtyard view toward the east gate. Long pale pointed arcades, central tall flat-roof portal with a broad pointed through arch, lower side portals and single octagonal minaret on a tiered square base to the gate’s right. The shaft rises to a projecting octagonal open-looking lantern and small pale domed cap. Roof edges have simple repeated parapet details. Exact lattice, staining, signs, fixtures and surrounding city are not copied.
